ar.title: شاورمة بخلطة سبايس

steps.n1: يقطع اللحم رفيعا كالأصابع، ثم يوضع في إناء به زيت على درجة حرارة هادئة مع تغطيته حتى يتشرب تماما ما به من ماء بدون أية توابل.
steps.n2: يضاف ماء يكفي لتغطيته، وعند تشرب اللحم تقريبا ثلاثة أرباع كمية الماء، تضاف خلطة السبايس ويقلب جيدا.
steps.n3: تقطع الطماطم والفلفل الأخضر قطعا صغيرة ثم تضاف إلى اللحم مع تقليبه تقليبة واحدة فقط.

en.title: Shawarma with Spice Blend
en.intro: This grilled dish showcases the Egyptian love of charred, aromatic meats. Long marination is key to tenderness and flavor absorption.

steps.n1: Cut the meat into thin, finger-like strips, then place it in a pot with oil over low heat, covered, without any seasoning, until it fully absorbs its own liquid.
steps.n2: Add enough water to cover it, and once the meat has absorbed about three-quarters of the water, add the spice packet and stir well.
steps.n3: Cut the tomato and green pepper into small pieces and add them to the meat with just one stir.

legacySteps: Cut the meat into thin, finger-like strips, then place it in a pot with oil over low heat, covered, without any seasoning, until it fully absorbs its own liquid.
Add enough water to cover it, and once the meat has absorbed about three-quarters of the water, add the spice packet and stir well.
Cut the tomato and green pepper into small pieces and add them to the meat with just one stir.
